key_insight: Prediction accuracy alone hides which response dimensions of the brain are captured by a model; the paper introduces a target-space recovery profile that reveals which subspaces of neural responses are recovered by model predictions. This unifies model–brain and brain–brain alignment assessments using repeated fMRI to identify true target dimensions.
problem_solved: Current evaluation practices use aggregate prediction accuracy to judge model–brain alignment, but accuracy does not show which specific neural response dimensions are recovered or missed—leading to misleading conclusions about functional similarity.
method: Use repeated fMRI measurements to identify reliable target response dimensions (the target response subspace) that truly reflect brain signal rather than noise.
Measure how much of that target subspace each model's predictions recover and summarize this as a target-space recovery profile across dimensions.
Compare model–brain recovery profiles to brain–brain alignment to quantify which dimensions are uniquely captured by models versus shared across brains.
impact: Provides a more informative evaluation tool for researchers and practitioners to understand not just how well models predict neural data but which aspects of neural representations they recover—helping guide model development and interpretation in neuroscience-aligned AI.
visual_elements: Schematic diagram: two high-dimensional spaces (brain target space and model prediction space) with the recovered subspace highlighted.
Bar or line chart: recovery profile showing recovered variance per target dimension for multiple models and for brain–brain baseline.
Scatter plot: prediction accuracy vs. recovered target-space fraction to illustrate when accuracy is misleading.
Brain map icon + small fMRI reliability inset: indicates use of repeated measurements to identify reliable target dimensions.
paper_title: Beyond Prediction Accuracy: Target-Space Recovery Profiles for Evaluating Model-Brain Alignment
paper_authors: Ken Nakamura, Tomoya Nakai, Ryuto Yashiro, Ayumu Yamashita, Kaoru Amano
